blocks.x: Failed deliveries down 34% — promise engine and exception agents
A parcel network (12M parcels/week) — a Logistics & Supply Chain engagement delivered by a blended Achala IT Solutions team under the outcome-linked engagement model.
Delivery windows missed; WISMO calls climbing.
Routing at daily scale exceeded solver time budgets. Parcel telemetry sparse; failed deliveries unexplained.

The promise engine produces confidence-banded ETAs per stop; a Quanta-inspired routing benchmark beat the incumbent engine by 4% daily distance (industrialized with warm starts); exception agents remediate address and availability issues through customer channels; parcel telemetry explains the rest.
